_comment: Frozen coverage floor (fleet T1 ratchet, Issue #155). Shrink-only: tools/coverage-ratchet.mjs fails CI if any metric drops below these values. Raise these numbers when coverage improves; never lower them. Regenerate the measurement with `npm run coverage`. 2026-07-21 (#162 barrel elimination): statements 40.70->40.51, lines 42.88->42.67 — the deleted `shared/ui` barrel force-loaded every component on any import (inflating module-load coverage); granular imports load only what's used, so a handful of never-tested module lines are now honestly uncovered. No test was removed and behavior is unchanged; the floor is lowered to the truer measurement per the ratchet's justified-drop path.
